Lines.en: This is looking worse... So much worse...
HAHA! Did you think it was over? I always have more zombies!
Your enthusiasm and determination is... rather inspiring, User Dave.
Can't give up. We must prevail.
Keep it! I found it in the trash but have it!
OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD OH MY GOD
HE HAD ONE! I KNEW HE HAD ONE!
I suppose you've earned yourself that treat, User Dave.
This journey was... seriously draining. I need a rest.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
Spreads by shooting spores at zombies
Rolls bouncing, explosive shots that redirect when hitting a zombie
Eats and blocks zombies, producing sun for each zombie eaten
Blocks zombies for long, damages nearby when bitten
Sends rapid thunder at high-value targets
Flings debuffing buds at zombies, more when powered
